question: The Kunbi dance is performed by the tribal community of ______.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kunbi dance is a tribal folk dance of the Kunbi community of Goa that portrays social themes.
 
• The dance is simple in its presentation and is performed during various social occasions.
 
• Kunbi (alternatively Kanbi) is a generic term applied to castes of traditionally non-elite farmers in Western India.
